items.text: Hey! Marcos here!
On this update, I'm adding an option on the main menu to disable/enable screenshake.
In several parts of the game, the screen shakes slightly giving a more impactful effect, like when you teleport, step on an interactive object or when Clawbert's Dad strikes with his claw.
Some people find this effect uncomfortable, so I'm adding an option to disable it! Just go to the game's Main Menu, then options, then select Toggle Screenshake.
One other thing on this update is that the game now has a secret level. That's all I'm gonna say. It's very, very well hidden.
Obviously there won't be any achievements tied to this secret level. It is so well hidden that I expect it will take a long time for even a single person to find it.
I added this kind of as a joke, so if I were you, I wouldn't get too hung up on this. Just look for it if you are a die hard fan of hidden things in games.
That's all for today, thank you for playing Dimensional Animals!
Hey! Marcos here bringing another update for Dimensional Animals!
The latest update brings you a new map marker, for keys!
Do you see it?
In every spot where there's an unused key, there will be a marker. This is specially useful for two situations:

1 - When you die, every key that you had in you returns to where it was originally. Previously, there wasn't a marker there to help you, so you had to rely on memory to find the key again. Now, though, there will be a marker reminding you where it is!
2 - When you change locations through a portal, again, every key that was on you returns to its origin. The marker will be very helpful here as well!
Gone are the days of being stuck on a locked door which you don't know where a key is at.

notes.title: Please note two additional IMPORTANT info about the key markers

items.text: 1 - When you get close to a key, the marker will be added automatically, which means the map won't already be full of markers. You have to find the keys yourself, just like the little yellow markers for collectible diamonds and orbs!

2 - Unfortunately, this update will only work for newly found keys. Which means that if you run the game in a slot that's already in progress, the keys that have already been found but not used won't have markers for them. You have to get close to them again to fill the marker.
Hopefully the key marker will make experiencing Dimensional Animals even more fun!
If you have any questions, just comment below.
Bye bye
Hello! Marcos here.
This is just a quick update making the performance on the game a little better. There were some unoptimal code involving the minimap and the trees from Cobalt Forest that are now fixed!
Hey, guys! Marcos here.
Today I bring a bug fix and a new addition to the game's exploration!

Fixed a bug found with the yellow sprite that appears on the map, showing you where there's an item. In any room with 2 or more upgrades, if you collected some of them but not all and then died, upon returning to the room to collect the rest would cause the yellow sprite to not disappear. It's fixed now!

And added a new map connection in Nightmare Land that allows you to climb the big falling area just before the boss fight. Once the boss is defeated, all these charge drones will be activated, allowing you to climb back upwards by using the frog skill!: Previously there were no charge drones, so the only way to go back up there was through severe backtracking. It was pretty inconvenient, but it's now fixed!: If you don't know which area I'm talking about, don't worry about it, this climb is very specific so it probably wasn't an inconvenient for you. Just know that there is one more way to navigate around this area, so it's pretty cool.: Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

releases.displayName: UPDATE! Upwards Teleport Fix + Other fixes

items.text: Hey guys! Bringing you another patch for Dimensional Animals.

notes.title: This one is aimed at fixing these issues

items.text: In certain framerates, when using the upwards teleport you'd freeze in mid-air. Sliding through the air like life has no problems. It is now fixed and also has a new effect, the game will enter slow motion for a fraction of a second to give you more time to think on your next aerial move.
Sometimes when grabbing a diamond or orb, the minimap symbol wouldn't disappear. With the current update it shouldn't happen anymore!
Sometimes the cursor on the main menu or pause menu would go CRAZY when using a gamepad's analog stick. It is now fixed!
Hello, everyone! Marcos here bringing another update to Dimensional Animals.
This is a big one, one that I feel we can call a major update, since it brings a rework to a boss in the game!
Don't worry, he still has the same attacks, but they feel a little better to play against.
So let's see what has been reworked on Cespuglio Bolshoi, the boss fight in Cobalt Forest:
The attack where the screen turns black, the boss disappears, you change position and minions are spawned.

My intention with this attack was always for it to feel like a prank. Since the boss shares similarities with the bush enemies from this level, I wanted one attack to have the same feel as the bushes.
Some people didn't like the black screen transition, as it felt too abrupt and too untied to the boss. So I changed the transition for it to look more like he is causing it.
Just a small fix on this one. This attack LOOKS like you can teleport across the boss, but you actually couldn't because his hitbox was way too big horizontally.

I always had the intention of making this attack avoidable only by the duck's double jump. But seeing as the animation makes it look like you can teleport across him, I decided to allow it, by decreasing the hitbox.
It will also make it a little easier to double jump above him! Which I think is still the easiest way to avoid the attack.

notes.title: This is how it looks right now

items.text: That's all for the boss's rework!
Every time you are on the same screen as a collectable, a yellow sprite will appear on your minimap location.
I forgot to add some of them, though!

For this reason, if you would collect something in a room that didn't have the yellow sprite in it, it would make another yellow sprite disappear! This could create a very problematic situation where you'd have the whole map explored while still missing a collectable, but without being able to see a yellow sprite pointing towards this missing collectable, making you run around the map trying to find it.
This is now fixed!
And that's it for this update! Hope you enjoy the changes.

releases.displayName: One last update for the day!

items.text: Hey guys, Marcos here again with one last update for today!

In the Cobalt Forest boss fight in the attack that he hides and teleports the player to a random position, when the boss teleported you to the left of the screen it had a chance of being way too close to an enemy bush. I made it so that you're positioned further to the left, a little farther from the first enemy bush, making it easier to avoid damage: Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

releases.displayName: Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements

items.text: Hey guys! Marcos here, bringing a batch of small bug fixes and game improvements.
On rare occasions the bubble enemy from world 3 would deal damage while sliding to a direction after being hit for the first time
Not a bug but a few people requested it so I added. You can now navigate menus using the analog stick on gamepads as well as the d-pad. Previously you could only use the d-pad
On regular occasions jumping with the frog from a wall would cause him to have no horizontal movement, which could lead to taking unfair damage on some situations
Spinning with the duck and then teleporting would sometimes take you to the wrong teleport direction: Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!
Hey guys. Just made a small update to the game!

The intro comic book is now skippable. If you hold the JUMP button, the cutscene will speed up but there will also be a progress bar to skip it completely. If you hold for about two seconds it will skip right into the gameplay.
The blowfishes on Pristine Beach stopped animating. Fixed that, they're animating again now.: Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!

Fixed an issue where the rematch against the Cobalt Forest boss would have the area music and the boss music playing at the same time: That's it! If you find issues or bugs, let me know! You can post them in the game's community: Thanks for playing Dimensional Animals!
